wineGlass.evidenceText: The public ROSSO red-wine section is explicitly labelled 150ml / 750ml. It lists Dolcetto d’Alba 105 DKK, Montepulciano d’Abruzzo 110 DKK, Barbera d’Alba Superiore 115 DKK, Pinot Noir Patricia 120 DKK, and Lagrein Granat 125 DKK for 150 ml glasses. Tax treatment is not stated.
